title: Relay mailbox acknowledge with a receipt read before the reader's own send fails with a misleading 423 Locked identity/home refusal
outcome: A receipt obtained from a relay mailbox read is either accepted for acknowledgement after the reader sends on the same mailbox, or refused with an error that names the actual cause (the receipt is superseded by the reader's own later message) instead of an authentication, identity or home refusal.
acceptance: A regression test reproduces the sequence relay read -> own send on the same relay mailbox -> acknowledge with the earlier receipt, and asserts the acknowledgement is accepted or the refusal names the superseded-receipt cause
The 423 'authenticated native mailbox relay refused; check original identity, home and request' text is no longer returned for a valid identity whose only problem is receipt currency
The relationship to the relay association/locator fix (w-009fe89b37b8) is recorded: either fixed by it or shown independent
